notes: This C++ TCK pair checks the §9.8.3 Invalid region rule for Subscribe Object Class Attributes With Regions. It supplies a default-invalid public RegionHandle as a regional designator and requires the standard InvalidRegion exception. It does not generalize to every invalid region lifecycle or region-context error.

requirements.statement: The subscriber supplies a RegionHandle that does not designate a region specification to Subscribe Object Class Attributes With Regions and verifies that the service throws InvalidRegion.
